raw_response:
*Thinking as the farmer...*

Hah, 1.2 mu only. You think I'm getting rich off this? It's my口粮田 — mouth-grain land. I'm 72, living by myself since the old lady passed and the kids are in the city. They send money, so I'm not starving. But I've been on this ground 40 years and I'm not going to let it go to weeds.

The land is too small to hire everything separate, but too much for these old bones to do by hand. So I call the 农机手 (machine operator) — same fellow as last year, Old Zhang from the next village. He does my tillage and harvest for both crops. Charges a bit more for small plots but what can I do.

**Wheat first** (we're at planting now, mid-October):

I plant the whole 1.2 mu in winter wheat. I use 济麦 variety — bought a new bag last year, saved some from this June's harvest for this planting. About 15 kg seed per mu, maybe a little thicker since I'm planting a touch late and the seedlings won't tiller as well.

Fertilizer — the 技术员 (extension guy) from the agricultural station tells us 15 kg N per mu is enough. But I always put down a bit more. I buy one bag of 复合肥 (compound 15-15-15) as base fertilizer, about 40 kg per mu broadcast before the rotary tiller goes over. Then at 返青 (green-up) in March I topdress urea, about 15 kg per mu. That's how I've done it for twenty years and the wheat comes out fine, 400-450 kg per mu most years.

Irrigation — I have to pump from the well, costs electricity. I do 越冬水 (pre-winter water) in late November, then 拔节水 (jointing water) in April, and 灌浆水 (grain-filling water) in May. Three times. If spring is really dry I might add one. Each time is maybe 40 yuan for my little plot.

Pesticide — I spray herbicide once in spring for 节节麦 and broadleaf weeds, and usually one fungicide spray around heading for 赤霉病 (scab) because the government推广 (extension) pushes it hard and last time I skipped it I got burned. Aphids I watch for — if I see them bad I'll mix something in with the fungicide spray, kill two birds.

**Maize after wheat** (plant around June 15, the day after wheat harvest):

Same 1.2 mu becomes maize. This is 抢时间 — racing against time. Old Zhang harvests the wheat, I rake the straw aside (或 he chops it), and the 免耕播种机 (no-till planter) comes the next day. Hybrid seed, 郑单 or 先玉 type, whatever the 农资店 has in stock — about 2.5 kg per mu, 60 yuan worth.

Fertilizer — with the no-till planter it puts down 种肥 (starter compound) as it plants, about 40 kg per mu of compound. Then when the maize is knee-high (大喇叭口 stage, around late July) I topdress urea by hand, about 20 kg per mu. Maize needs nitrogen when it's growing fast.

Irrigation — summer is rainy season, usually I only need to irrigate once, at tasseling time if July is dry. Some years zero times. Lucky crop that way.

Pesticide — one herbicide application after planting (atrazine mix), and I watch for 草地贪夜蛾 (fall armyworm) — that pest showed up a few years back and extension warns about it every year. If I see damage I spray.

Harvest late September with Old Zhang's combine, sell what I don't keep for myself and the chickens.

**My main worry this year** — my back has been bad since winter, so the manual topdressing and spraying is hard. I may have to pay my nephew to help a couple days. Cash is tight — kids send 2000 yuan a month but inputs for both crops eat up maybe 1000 yuan of that across the year. Fertilizer prices went up again. I'll stick with what works, not try anything new at my age.
